Let's start by listing your debts. Use the buttons below.

Debts come in 3 flavours:
1, Credit Cards,
2, Formal Loans, and
3, Friends and Family Loans.

Analyse debts using buttons above.
Graph showing overall debt (red) decreasing over time. Individual debts (grey) are paid in a highest interest first manner.
Set a budget and stick to it! It wont be easy but it will be worth it.
Seriously! Leave credit cards at home. Use only your debit/checking account to live. Sell things you don\'t use.

It\'s hard to account for everything in reality but this is a worthwhile exercise. Ensure that your debts are the first thing you pay off when you get paid. If you can\'t make payments, talk to your bank.

If your debt is made up of credit and store cards with high rates of interest you need to find a source of lending at a lower rate. This will mean that you pay off more capital each month and less interest.
It\'s time to track what you should be paying off and when (click the icon up top for a table). It\'s good to see how far you\'ve come! It will motivate you to clear that debt and stay debt free.
